question: 查询所有有效订单的总销售金额。
intended_meaning: 计算 orders 表中 order_status 属于 ('paid','completed','shipped') 的所有订单的 paid_amount 总和。
reference_sql: SELECT SUM(paid_amount) FROM orders WHERE order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped');

question: 列出所有在售商品的名称和所属品类。
intended_meaning: 从 products 表中筛选 is_active = 1 的记录，返回 product_name 和 category 字段。
reference_sql: SELECT product_name, category FROM products WHERE is_active = 1;

question: 统计所有有效订单对应的付费用户数。
intended_meaning: 统计 orders 表中 order_status 属于 ('paid','completed','shipped') 的订单所关联的去重 user_id 数量。
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM orders WHERE order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped');

question: 按城市分组，统计各城市有效订单的销售金额，并降序排列。
intended_meaning: 连接 orders 和 users 表，按 users.city 分组，对有效订单的 paid_amount 求和，结果按销售金额降序排列。
reference_sql: SELECT u.city, SUM(o.paid_amount) AS sales_amount FROM orders o JOIN users u ON o.user_id = u.user_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') GROUP BY u.city ORDER BY sales_amount DESC;

question: 计算所有有效订单中商品的平均购买数量。
intended_meaning: 连接 orders 和 order_items 表，对 order_status 属于 ('paid','completed','shipped') 的订单对应的所有 order_items.quantity 计算平均值。
reference_sql: SELECT AVG(oi.quantity) FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped');

question: 按品牌分组，统计各品牌有效订单的商品销售金额，并取前5名。
intended_meaning: 连接 orders、order_items 和 products 表，按 products.brand 分组，对有效订单中各商品 line 的 item_amount 求和，取销售金额最高的前5个品牌。
reference_sql: SELECT p.brand, SUM(oi.item_amount) AS sales_amount FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') GROUP BY p.brand ORDER BY sales_amount DESC LIMIT 5;

question: 统计各品类的有效订单销售金额与已批准退款金额，并计算退款率。
intended_meaning: 连接 orders、order_items、products 和 refunds 表，按 products.category 分组，分别计算有效订单的 item_amount 总和与 refund_status='approved' 的 refund_amount 总和，再计算退款率（退款金额 / 销售金额）。
reference_sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.item_amount) AS sales_amount, COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_amount), 0) AS refund_amount, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_amount), 0) / NULLIF(SUM(oi.item_amount), 0), 4) AS refund_rate FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id LEFT JOIN refunds r ON oi.order_item_id = r.order_item_id AND r.refund_status = 'approved' WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') GROUP BY p.category;

question: 计算手机数码类商品的产品退款率。
intended_meaning: 限定品类为'手机数码'，计算该品类下所有有效订单对应商品的已批准退款金额总和除以该品类商品销售金额总和（四舍五入保留4位小数）。
reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_amount), 0) / NULLIF(SUM(oi.item_amount), 0), 4) AS refund_rate FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id LEFT JOIN refunds r ON oi.order_item_id = r.order_item_id AND r.refund_status = 'approved' WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') AND p.category = '手机数码';

question: 统计各类已批准退款原因的出现次数。
intended_meaning: 从 refunds 表中筛选 refund_status = 'approved' 的记录，按 refund_reason 分组计数。
reference_sql: SELECT refund_reason, COUNT(*) AS count FROM refunds WHERE refund_status = 'approved' GROUP BY refund_reason;

question: 按月份统计2026年各月有效订单的销售金额。
intended_meaning: 从 orders 表中提取 order_date 的年份和月份，筛选2026年且 order_status 属于 ('paid','completed','shipped') 的订单，按年月分组求 paid_amount 总和，并按时间升序排列。
reference_sql: SELECT YEAR(order_date) AS year, MONTH(order_date) AS month, SUM(paid_amount) AS sales_amount FROM orders WHERE order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') AND YEAR(order_date) = 2026 GROUP BY YEAR(order_date), MONTH(order_date) ORDER BY year, month;
